title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Mason Taylor (back) limited at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Mason Taylor (back) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Taylor's back injury left him limited at practice on Wednesday. It doesn't seem to be a serious issue at this point, however, so it looks likely that he will play and see his usual workload against the Chiefs this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: David Bailey (groin) considered limited Wednesday
items.desc: David Bailey (groin) was considered a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Bailey was sidelined in Week 8 while dealing with a groin issue, but he was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday and seems to be on track to play on Sunday. New York's defensive front will be close to full strength once again if he's available to play this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Garrett Wilson (concussion) doesn't practice Wednesday
items.desc: Garrett Wilson (concussion) did not take part in New York's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Wilson was recently placed in the NFL's concussion protocols and wasn't able to practice on Wednesday as a result. It looks like a long shot that he will be cleared to play in time for Sunday's game, and if he's ruled out, Adonai Mitchell and Omar Cooper Jr. should both see a substantial increase in opportunities in his absence.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cody White released by Raiders
items.desc: The Raiders released WR Cody White.
items.impact: White has hauled in three touchdowns this season. He has also played a role on special teams.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Breece Hall (quad) limited at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Breece Hall (quad) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: As expected, Hall was a limited participant to start the week on Wednesday. He seems to be very close to a return from his quad injury, but there also remains a slight chance that he will be traded in the near future, so fantasy managers should continue to monitor his status closely throughout the rest of the week to see if he will play in Week 9.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Rashee Rice (hamstring/knee) limited at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Rashee Rice (hamstring/knee) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Rice is dealing with a pair of injuries right now and was limited at practice on Wednesday as a result. He should still be available to play in Week 9, but we won't get an official injury decision for him until later on in the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Mansoor Delane (shoulder) limited participant Wednesday
items.desc: Mansoor Delane (shoulder) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Delane was sidelined last week while recovering from a shoulder issue. He was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday, however, which puts him on track to play in Week 9. Kansas City's secondary will get a nice boost if he's back in the lineup this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jordan Whittington (back) practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Jordan Whittington will be limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Whittington remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Steve Avila (hamstring) practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Steve Avila will be limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Avila remains up in the air heading into Week 9.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Travis Kelce (ankle) limited at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Travis Kelce (ankle) was limited at Kansas City's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran was limited for the team's first practice of the week on Wednesday. He's still managing an ankle issue of some kind, but it isn't likely to leave him sidelined in Week 9. He will continue to be a decently safe PPR option on a week-to-week basis moving forward.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Grant Stuard (hamstring) practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Grant Stuard will be limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Stuard was considered week-to-week to begin the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Joe Cardona (ankle) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Joe Cardona is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Cardona is working his way through an ankle injury. His status will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kam Curl (foot) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Kam Curl is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Curl is working his way through a foot injury. His status will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Colby Parkinson (ribs) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Colby Parkinson is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Parkinson did not play in last Sunday's win over the Chargers. His status for Week 9 remains up in the air.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Trent McDuffie (back) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Trent McDuffie is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: McDuffie is continuing to work his way through a back injury. His status heading into Week 9 is uncertain.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Morgan Moses (foot) limited Wednesday
items.desc: Morgan Moses (foot) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Unsurprisingly, the veteran was limited at practice on Wednesday due to the same foot issue that has been bothering him for a while. He's likely to play through it in Week 9, however, which is good news for New England's offensive front.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaylen Watson (shoulder) to undergo season-ending surgery
items.desc: Rams head coach Sean McVay said Jaylen Watson will have shoulder surgery and is out for the season.
items.impact: Watson aggravated his shoulder injury this past week. He will miss the rest of the season.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Greg Van Roten (hamstring) limited Wednesday
items.desc: Greg Van Roten (hamstring) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Van Roten was recently designated to return from injured reserve and returned to practice as a limited participant on Wednesday. The veteran will likely make his return to the lineup sometime within the next couple of weeks, which will be helpful depth for a Patriots' offensive front struggling with injuries right now.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Mack Hollins (calf) officially limited Wednesday
items.desc: Mack Hollins (calf) was officially limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Hollins made his return to practice on Wednesday as a limited participant. He has been on injured reserve for a while due to a calf issue, but it looks like he will be back in the lineup very soon. He isn't likely to have a lot of individual fantasy value moving forward, but his eventual return should help QB Drake Maye substantially.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Hunter Henry (foot) doesn't practice Wednesday
items.desc: Hunter Henry (foot) did not take part in New England's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Henry suffered a foot injury last week and was not able to practice on Wednesday as a result. It could leave him sidelined in Week 9 as well, which would lead to more work for rookie Eli Raridon against the Packers.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chris Brooks (ankle) listed as limited Wednesday
items.desc: Chris Brooks (ankle) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Brooks was recently designated to return from injured reserve and made his return to practice on Wednesday. He was a limited participant, which makes his status for Week 9 unclear for the time being. He will be a depth piece behind Josh Jacobs whenever he's back and available to play for the Packers.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Micah Parsons (knee) officially limited Wednesday
items.desc: Micah Parsons (knee) was officially limited at Green Bay's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Parsons made his return to practice on Wednesday after missing an extended period of time while recovering from a significant knee injury. He was limited in his first day back, and he is unlikely to be ready to play in Week 9. Still, his return should come soon, which will offer a significant boost for Green Bay's defensive front moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Christian Watson (rib) limited at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Christian Watson (rib) was limited at Green Bay's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Watson suffered a rib injury in Green Bay's win over the Panthers last week, which left him limited at the team's practice on Wednesday. It looks like he's on track to be a full go for Week 9, but we won't know his official status until later on in the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Terrance Ferguson (ankle) will practice Wednesday
items.desc: Terrance Ferguson will practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Ferguson will have his practice window opened. He'll have 21 days to officially be activated. He is worth stashing for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Myles Garrett (knee) will practice Wednesday
items.desc: Myles Garrett will practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Garrett has had his practice window opened. It is unclear if he will be activated this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Aaron Banks (knee) limited Wednesday
items.desc: Aaron Banks (knee) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran was limited at Green Bay's practice on Wednesday due to a knee issue that continues to linger for him. He should play through it in Week 9, however, assuming he suffers no setbacks between now and then.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyler Smith limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Tyler Smith was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Smith is on track to be good to go for Sunday's game against the Colts.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: George Pickens limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: George Pickens was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Pickens is on track to be good to go for Sunday's game against the Colts. He'll remain a volatile WR2 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kelvin Banks Jr. (ankle) returns to limited practice Wednesday
items.desc: Kelvin Banks Jr. (ankle) returned to practice as a limited participant on Wednesday.
items.impact: Banks was able to return to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday. He is considerably ahead of his original injury timeline right now and could be back in the lineup sometime within the next couple of weeks. New Orleans' offensive front will see a considerable upgrade whenever he's back in the lineup for them.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jake Ferguson (ankle) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Jake Ferguson is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Ferguson left last week's game early with an ankle injury. His status is uncertain for Week 9.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Caleb Downs not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Caleb Downs is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Downs will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tank Dell expected to see increase in snaps
items.desc: Texans head coach DeMeco Ryans said WR Tank Dell's snap will go up.
items.impact: Ryans clarified that it isn't because Jaylin Noel is out but because the natural progression of Dell working his way back. He remains a risky start for fantasy managers.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) officially limited Wednesday
items.desc: Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) was officially limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The rookie was officially able to take part in New Orleans' practice on Wednesday. He has yet to make his NFL debut due to a nagging hamstring issue that he has been managing, but he seems to be close to full health and is officially in his 21-day practice window. Fantasy managers should keep close tabs on updates about his health, as he could be a relevant player down the stretch if he makes his NFL debut sooner rather than later.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jacob Saylors (neck) limited participant Wednesday
items.desc: Jacob Saylors (neck) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Saylors was a limited participant at Wednesday's practice after suffering a neck issue of some kind in last week's game. It could leave him sidelined in Week 9, but we won't have a better idea of his official status until later on in the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mike Evans (Achilles) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Mike Evans is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Evans missed the 49ers Week 7 loss against the Falcons before the bye week. His status is uncertain heading into Week 9.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Christian McCaffrey (hamstring) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Christian McCaffrey is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: McCaffrey got banged up in the loss against the Falcons before the bye week. He'll need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jaylen Wright (quad) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Jaylen Wright (quad) missed Miami's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Wright wasn't able to practice on Wednesday. He's dealing with a quad injury right now and was a non-participant as a result. It could leave him sidelined in Week 9, which would likely lead to more work for Kaytron Allen (quad) as a depth piece in the backfield.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kaytron Allen (quad) listed as limited Wednesday
items.desc: Kaytron Allen (quad) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Allen is currently managing a quad issue of some kind and was limited at practice on Wednesday as a result. He could see more work in Week 9 if Jaylen Wright (quad) is unable to play against the Lions.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Demarcus Robinson (ankle) designated to return to practice
items.desc: The 49ers designated WR Demarcus Robinson to return to practice.
items.impact: Robinson is working his way back from an ankle injury. He'll have 21 days to officially be activated.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nate Hobbs designated to return to practice
items.desc: The 49ers designated Nate Hobbs to return to practice.
items.impact: Hobbs will have 21 days to officially be activated by San Francisco.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Amon-Ra St. Brown (rib) limited at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Amon-Ra St. Brown (rib) was limited at Detroit's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: St. Brown was estimated to be a limited participant on Wednesday's injury report. He suffered a rib injury in Week 8, but he was able to finish the game, so it looks likely that he will be able to play through it in Week 9, though we won't know for sure until later on in the week. He remains a must-start if he's cleared to play this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nick Bosa (knee/calf) expected to return in Week 9
items.desc: Nick Bosa is expected to return for Sunday's game against the Raiders.
items.impact: Bosa was limited in practice on Wednesday to begin the week. He told reporters he feels "great" and he's "ready to go."

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Abdul Carter 'should be fine' for Week 9
items.desc: Giants head coach John Harbaugh said Abdul Carter "should be fine" for Sunday's game against the Eagles.
items.impact: Carter has been sidelined from practice to start the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) remains day-to-day
items.desc: Giants head coach John Harbaugh said Cam Skattebo remains day-to-day.
items.impact: Skattebo did not practice on Wednesday. He'll need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Trevor Keegan claimed off waivers by Buccaneers
items.desc: The Buccaneers claimed G Trevor Keegan off waivers from the Vikings.
items.impact: Keegan will add depth on the offensive line for Tampa Bay.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: David Montgomery (groin) ruled out for Sunday
items.desc: David Montgomery (groin) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Los Angeles Chargers.
items.impact: Montgomery is reportedly progressing in the right direction with his injury recovery, but he will not be available to play on Sunday and is going to be sidelined against the Chargers. Woody Marks and Jawhar Jordan will likely continue to see additional touches while the veteran remains out.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jakobi Meyers (hamstring/ankle) off injury report for Thursday
items.desc: Jakobi Meyers (hamstring/ankle) is off of the injury report for Thursday night's game against the Baltimore Ravens.
items.impact: Meyers has been dealing with a pair of injuries lately, but neither of them are serious and he will be good to go for Thursday night's game. He isn't expected to be a reliable fantasy option on a week-to-week basis even if active, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ezra Cleveland (knee/ankle) cleared to play Thursday
items.desc: Ezra Cleveland (knee/ankle) has been cleared to play in Thursday's game against the Baltimore Ravens.
items.impact: Cleveland is going to be good to go for Thursday night's game, despite dealing with a pair of injuries at practice throughout the week. Jacksonville's offensive front will be stronger with him available to play against Baltimore.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chris Rodriguez Jr. (hand) good to go for Thursday
items.desc: Chris Rodriguez Jr. (hand) is good to go for Thursday night's game against the Baltimore Ravens.
items.impact: Rodriguez was limited at practice all week due to a hand issue, but it's not a serious issue and he is officially good to go for Thursday night's game. Look for him to see a lot more work than usual if Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot) is ruled out against the Ravens.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot) officially questionable for Thursday
items.desc: Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot) is officially questionable for Thursday night's game against the Baltimore Ravens.
items.impact: Tuten wasn't able to practice all week due to an ankle/foot issue that he's dealing with, and now he is officially considered questionable to play on Thursday night because of it. It sounds like he is expected to be a game-time decision, so fantasy managers should keep close tabs on updates about his status leading up to kickoff and should have a good backup option in place in case he's out.
